address: B2, Regent Hotel, 3, Lane 39, Section 2, Zhongshan North Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: The Latin "circum-" is related to "circle", a symbol of wholeness and unity in Chinese culture. The kitchen team traces the footsteps of Chinese emigrants throughout history, exploring how their food culture evolves over time and across territories. Inspired by classic recipes, childhood memories and anecdotes collected overseas, they deliver an engaging dining experience based on literature, narratives and solid French technique. The carefully composed dishes, highlighting a broad spectrum of Chinese flavours, feel both familiar and refreshing.
